description: The exact JSON your Business Rule sends to POST /webhook. Field names must match exactly.

fields.incident_sys_id: string — the sys_id of the incident record (used for the write-back)
fields.number: string — the incident number, e.g. INC0010001
fields.short_description: string — one-line summary typed by the user
fields.description: string — longer detail, may be empty

example.short_description: Printer not printing after office move
example.description: It was working yesterday. I tried turning it off and on.
